How to use

1. Place favicon.ico at the site root (public/).
2. Add this line in <head>:
   <link rel="icon" href="/favicon.ico">
3. For high-DPI displays, also include the PNG:
   <link rel="icon" type="image/png" sizes="32x32" href="/favicon-32.png">

http-status.searchPlaceholder: Search by code (404), name (Not Found), or keyword

desc.103: Hints provided before the final response (e.g., Link headers).
desc.200: Request succeeded — the default success for GET/POST.
desc.202: Accepted, but processing is asynchronous / deferred.
desc.204: Succeeded with no body — often used for DELETE.
desc.206: Partial response for a Range request.
desc.301: Moved permanently — redirect to the new URL.
desc.302: Found (temporary move). The original URL remains valid.
desc.303: After a POST, redirect using GET (Post/Redirect/Get).
desc.304: Cache is still valid — use the cached body.
desc.402: Payment required (rarely used; some APIs use it).
desc.403: Forbidden — authenticated but access is denied.
desc.405: HTTP method not allowed (e.g., POST to a GET-only URL).
desc.406: Cannot return content that matches the Accept header.
desc.409: Conflict with current state (e.g., concurrent edits).
desc.412: A conditional header (If-Match, etc.) did not match.
desc.418: A joke code (RFC 2324). Some sites use it for bot blocking.
desc.422: Syntactically valid but failed semantic validation.
desc.425: Refused due to risk of a replay attack.
desc.428: A conditional request is required (conflict prevention).
desc.429: Rate limit exceeded — check the Retry-After header.
desc.501: Server has not implemented this method / feature.
desc.502: A gateway / proxy received an invalid response upstream.
